_comment: Tiers whose weapons are assembled from parts instead of crafted whole, because that is how
the host mod builds its own tools. A tier listed here gets NO shaped recipe. Instead each
weapon gets a head item, and the weapon itself is a smithing_transform of that head.
Better End never crafts a tool from ingots. It forges a blade on an anvil, smiths a handle
separately, then joins the two with the tool assembly template. Ours does the same:
1. head   - anvil recipe, <count> tier ingots -> knavesneeds:<mod>/<tier>/<weapon>_head
anvil_level / anvil_damage / anvil_tools per tier are copied from Better End's own
*_sword_blade recipes - the sword row specifically, since ours are weapons and their tool
heads use a harsher tool tag. The head's ingot count is NOT invented either: it reuses the
same per-shape material count the old shaped recipes used, read straight out of
sword_patterns.json, so switching Better End onto smithing changes the method without
quietly changing what a weapon costs.
head_templates lists weapons whose head has a hand-authored 3D model in the mod's
item/templates/. Everything else is a flat minecraft:item/generated sprite. greathammer is
there because its head is geometry rather than a drawn sprite - and it is also the one shape
with no *_head.png, so its head model falls back to the ordinary greathammer texture.
